prompts.a:

Primary request: translate the supplied male Fixer concept into a single square head-and-shoulders pixel-art portrait. Closely preserve THIS CHARACTER'S identity, charisma, and costume. He is a handsome but weathered adult camp broker in his forties, tousled medium-short wavy dark brown hair with a conspicuous silver streak at one temple, arched dark eyebrows, shrewd hazel eyes, a small moustache and neat pointed goatee, a slightly crooked closed-mouth knowing smile. Input image: the supplied full-body male Fixer is the identity and costume reference, not just mood.
Costume: the distinctive worn burgundy-red brocade coat with broad turned lapels, tarnished understated gold edging, ochre/mustard patterned waistcoat, rumpled ivory shirt and dark loosely knotted neckcloth; brown satchel strap across the chest. At the lower crop edge a sliver of worn ledger may be visible, but prioritize face, red lapels, ochre waistcoat and neckcloth. No hands or large props.

Constraints: open attentive eyes, closed resting lips. Genuine transparent alpha outside the character. No camp scenery, backdrop, text, border, logo, crown, helmet, weapons, armour or padded jerkin. Do not flatten his smile into a stern expression.
